name: Dolly In
description: Camera moves forward toward the subject.

name: Dolly Out
description: Camera moves backward away from the subject.

name: Dolly Left
description: Camera slides left, keeping its aim.

name: Dolly Right
description: Camera slides right, keeping its aim.

name: Dolly Zoom In
description: Camera moves in while the lens widens to a wider field of view.

name: Dolly Zoom Out
description: Camera moves back while the lens narrows to a tighter field of view.

name: Orbit Left
description: Camera circles the subject to its left, clockwise seen from above.

name: Orbit Right
description: Camera circles the subject to its right, counter-clockwise seen from above.

name: Pan Left
description: Camera turns its view left in place.

name: Pan Right
description: Camera turns its view right in place.

name: Tilt Up
description: Camera pitches its view upward in place.

name: Tilt Down
description: Camera pitches its view downward in place.
